programme.title: Crafting Cabinet Doors: Materials & Cutting Techniques
programme.desc: In the episode the craftsman guides viewers through essential techniques and considerations for crafting cabinet doors with precision and efficiency. He begins by stressing the importance of wood selection, advising against woods with prominent grain patterns like oak, which are unsuitable for door frames. Instead, he recommends using straight-grained pieces from the edges of the wood or opting for materials like MDF, birch, or maple for paint-grade projects due to their smooth surfaces and availability in large sheets. The craftsman demonstrates how to prepare materials for construction, including ripping pieces for frames and face frames, and discusses the suitability of poplar for practice due to its affordability and ease of machining. When it comes to door panels, he explains the careful use of plywood and the importance of adjusting grooves precisely for optimal fit. He showcases the use of a dado head to create tenons that snugly fit into these grooves, ensuring strong and gap-free assembly. Techniques for creating specific door styles are highlighted, such as using half-lap joints adjusted on the table saw for flush fits. The craftsman emphasizes marking and consistent cuts to avoid errors, crucial for achieving perfect joints in door frame assembly. He demonstrates assembly steps and discusses adding decorative pegs for both aesthetic appeal and structural integrity, particularly useful for heavier doors like those with leaded glass panels. Throughout the episode, the craftsman underscores the use of templates for ensuring consistent shapes, particularly useful for cathedral-style doors. He employs a band saw and router table with double-sided tape to achieve precision in shaping components, emphasizing careful setup and sequential cuts for optimal woodworking results. Overall, the episode provides comprehensive guidance on wood selection, tool adjustment, joint creation, and assembly techniques, empowering woodworkers to create high-quality cabinet doors effectively.

programme.title: Under Control
programme.desc: Control is not the first word that comes to mind when thinking of modern quilting, but there are some techniques that can benefit by keeping things under control. Catherine Cureton illustrates the idea of controlled scrappy quilting. She has a new method for sorting fabrics that allows for stress free scrappy quilting. Then, Audrey Esarey has the guide for sewing curves. Keep stitching under control with some simple tips for curves. Then it's tips for walking foot quilting with Eliane Bergmann in the machine tip.

programme.title: Friendship Stars Quilt
programme.desc: Are you Quilt Curious, but unsure where to get started? THIS is the Midnight Quilt Show episode for you!

programme.title: Knit Techniques to Make You a Hero
programme.desc: Knits are one of the trendiest fabrics for your garment sewing but there are some techniques that make your knits look more professional whether done on a serger or sewing machine. Sarah Gunn is up first, with knit tips for hem and neck finishing that will give you professional results. Then Londa Rolfing shows: how to manage bulky edges when sewing, tips for elastic, ways to eliminate diagonal drag on fabric and finishes up with three things to know when a serger thread breaks. Last is Angela Wolf and another variation on the A line skirt- this time it's a knit maxi.

programme.title: Sewing to the Rescue
programme.desc: Go thru those old linens that you can't bear to part with, and join Michelle Paganini as she rescues them with an upcycle project turning them into travel and accessory bags. Great for young family members to get to know their heritage and for older family members to remember and reflect.

Finally, take a road trip to the Columbus Idea Foundry, a center for the growing Maker Movement.

Julie shares a last tip for transforming die cuts with a variety of techniques and tools, from doodles and stamps to markers and pens.

programme.desc: Machine quilting isn't always as easy as it looks, but anyone can do these three free-motion quilting designs (promise)! Learn how wavy lines, starburst designs, and simple cursive words can turn your quilt into a work of art.

programme.desc: Learn the details that will make your wardrobe a classic. There are little details that make a garment stand the test of time and they usually involve some sort of detail from the couture world. They are not necessarily difficult or time consuming -- but they show you took that extra step to make your garment a classic. Amy Alan demonstrates serging -- one of those techniques that is always classic. Then, we have another lesson of the Little Black Dress with Angela Wolf and how to use the lining as your facing. Finally, couture expert Susan Khalje has some special finish details for a professional look.

programme.desc: How do you get a great episode? Just add color! Join the girls for a colorful chat full of fun projects, bright hues, and yes, even a crocheted pizza hat.

programme.title: Symmetry
programme.desc: Today's theme is symmetry -- something is exactly the same on both sides of a dividing line or center. It can also refer to a balanced arrangement of the parts of a whole. The first project is a mixed media collage that features symmetrical feather shapes. Next, build and decorate a sandcastle. Create jeweled crowns that are exactly the same on both sides. Then, make mirror images on facing pages in your art journal. Last, Make a survivor belt with special findings featuring a symmetrical design.

programme.desc: Head to the great outdoors with camping crafts. Jenny Barnett-Rohrs fashions a talking stick like those used by ancient tribes. Then, she paints images of nature with sand. programme.desc: This season we're exploring how to develop your sense of place and how it influences our design. One factor we haven't touched upon is designing with a strong focus on the end product and its use. Today is all about cuffs. They provide a different surface and a design aesthetic based on their shape. Leslie Rogalski is first with centerline cuffs with a Native American design. Then Candie Cooper uses leather for her cuff design. Finally, Tammy Honaman is back for another short lesson, featuring safety tips for working with enamel.

programme.desc: As the first World War began, supplies became scarce. Women joined the workforce as men fought overseas. Fashions became less restrictive, bustles disappeared and the silhouette became sleeker. Designers used scraps for embellishment and manipulated fabric to create design details. Rebecca Kemp Brent shows how to create beautiful scrap fabric flowers. Angela Wolf uses couture draping techniques to add fashion flair to a straight skirt.

programme.title: Perspective
programme.desc: Today's show is all about perspective or how we see objects in space. Perspective is the technique of representing three dimensional objects on a two dimensional space -- like drawing a house on a flat piece of paper. It's all a point of view from which we categorize or measure -- like a tree that gets smaller and smaller as we walk away from it. Our first example is an optical treasure box with geometric patterns. Next, build your own kaleidoscope. Add to your art journal -- how perspective makes buildings and other city scenes more realistic. Finally, make a lightweight ball with streamers and watch it fly through the air and learn about perspective.

Artist Franz Spohn draws creatures that are just like us – or not. Jenny uses glow-in-the-dark clay to craft a spooky-sweet charm for your backpack.

Then Katie is back with old meets new, as we look at new ways to set crystals. Finally Tammy shows us new and old loom types.

programme.title: Gluing and Clamping Tips

programme.title: Cathedral Window Pillow
programme.desc:
The holidays are coming, but don't stress! We teamed up with Angela Walters, host of the Midnight Quilt Show, to create three DIY quilt projects that are super gift-able. In this episode, you'll learn how to make a cathedral window pillow, an adorable gift for someone in your life who you've deemed "quilt-worthy."
P.S. Don't miss Angela's tips for non-quilters on what to do (and what NOT to do!) when you receive a gift from a quilter...

programme.title: Quilting is in Fashion
programme.desc: Today's show takes a look at quilting in a whole new way, as common quilt techniques find their way into fashion. Quilting is not just for on your bed -- Angela Wolf introduces the practice of quilting the lining to your garment -- just like the couture designers, without batting. Then it's a turn to traditional quilting with an easy paper piecing technique from Rebecca Kemp Brent

programme.title: The Stylish Girl

programme.title: Bench Jewelry Techniques

programme.title: Semi Precious

programme.title: Episode 5: Books

programme.title: It's All in the Timing

Finally, Joe Rotella makes a wine cork shadow box personalized with a favorite sentiment.

programme.title: Black And Arab
programme.desc: Nareeman Dosa - Saudi-born, and of Sudanese heritage, - grew up in the Arab world experiencing the casual racism that most Black Arabs face. In Black and Arab, she visits Tunisia, the first Arab country to have made racial discrimination a criminal offence, embarking on a journey to explore whether the law can alter deep-rooted prejudice, as well as speaking to other Black Arabs for whom racism has been a sadly pervasive part of their existence.

programme.title: Sheltered
programme.desc: In the busy world of the animal shelter, the loving bond between humans and animals is strained by the endless stream of abandoned cats, dogs, and rabbits. Pets are life companions - but for some, they are dispensable. With care and training by the passionate employees and dedicated volunteers, the hopeful animals are rehabilitated. Not every story has a happy ending, but the team fights on - even for the biggest misfits of them all.

programme.title: A Man & His Trumpet: The Leroy Jones Story
programme.desc: Follow the fascinating life story of trumpeter Leroy Jones. From the projects of New Orleans, Jones goes on to lead the brass band revival, and eventually catches the ear of Harry Connick Jr., and becomes known worldwide.

programme.title: Combat Forces
programme.desc: House-to-house combat is one of the most brutal and intense types of land warfare. Recent conflicts in Bosnia, Somalia and Iraq have reinforced the need for training in this specialized skill set. At urban warfare training facilities throughout the world, we learn first-hand what it takes to survive!

programme.title: Turning a Blind Eye
programme.desc: In October 2019 an unthinkable tragedy hit the peaceful village of Jura in Switzerland. Christophe Keller slit his wife Mélanie's throat before cutting his own. The crime shocked the whole country. What had happened between this couple, living a seemingly ordinary life with their three children? Each year, nearly 90,000 women are killed by their partner or ex-partner throughout the world. Could more have been done to save Mélanie?

programme.title: Alaska Long Hunters
programme.desc: A true life adventure set in 60's Alaska, Documenting a young pilots life who through it all, meets his creator God and finds life's true meaning. Based on the book "Last of the Long Hunters" by Mark Rose (2015) This story records the life of a young pilot flying in Alaska's Frontier Arctic. You'll experience the front seat thrills of bush planes and helicopters operating in the most dangerous conditions on Earth. Flying in minus 60 temperatures and horrific storms, airborne among the magnificent mountains, glaciers and rivers that only Alaska has to offer. Once you've read this volume you'll not be satisfied until you visit Alaska yourself. Includes true-life experiences of accidents, comradeship, humor, heartbreaks and life in Frontier Alaska, gone forever when dismantled into parks and native lands in the 1970's.

programme.title: The Time of Their Lives
programme.desc: The ultimate coming-of-age movie. With a combined age of almost 300, Hetty, Rose and Alison love to share their concerns on everything from terrorism and global warming to sex, death and the meaning of life. The Time of Their Lives reveals the everyday mystery of how very old people experience life and the intense challenges that old age brings. Like first-hand witnesses reporting back from the edge of their own mortality, Hetty, Rose and Alison tell us things which are never spoken of.

programme.title: An Italian Youth
programme.desc: Mathieu Volpe, film director invites us to follow Sokuro over a long period of time. Through a few key moments in the love story between Sokuro and Nassira, he offers another perspective on economic migration, which through this embodied representation takes on a more intimate quality. Regret, nostalgia and lack are the side effects of these reluctant exiles, done out of necessity rather than desire, that are too often kept in the shadows. By offering faces and bodies to a current topic, by embodying it and taking the time to explore its complexity, documentary cinema allows to deepen our reflection; Sokuro and Nassira’s contradictory yet profoundly human aspirations as well as their story is superimposed over the media narratives around the subject, enriching and humanising them.

programme.title: Combat Forces
programme.desc: Artillery is known as the King of Battle and for over 100 years it has played a pivotal role in combat. In this fascinating episode we learn how artillery works, what ammunition it fires and how it plays an important role in modern combat. We join gunners preparing for deployment to Iraq and Afghanistan who are on exercise.

programme.title: A Gentleman Thief
programme.desc: Vincenzo Pipino is a thief, he was convicted and has done over 25 years in prison both in Italy and in the rest of Europe and has expiated his faults. The documentary tells the story of this last gentleman thief.

programme.title: Undercover Jihadi
programme.desc: Each time a young man leaves a quiet suburb to join ISIS, we are shocked. Why do they do it? How can they be stopped? And if they come back, what to do about them? These are the questions that drive Mubin Shaikh on his quest to stop potential jihadis. Mubin went from militant extremist to undercover operative. Now a Counter-Terrorism expert, he takes to the frontlines of the battle against violent extremism around the world.

programme.title: Echoes Of The Empire: Beyond Genghis
programme.desc: Mongolia: for most of us, it brings to mind Genghis Khan's mighty empire. But in the present day, there is also a rich culture in the nation that grew from the ashes of Genghis Khan's triumphs, and a complex history aside from the bloodshed and conquest. A stunning cinematic view of the country's past and present, from the remarkable evolution of the Mongol Empire to intimate portraits of today’s Mongolians.

programme.title: Ambulance
programme.desc: When a talented young filmmaker tells the story of his country with compassion, beauty, and warmth in an honest, straight and raw first-person account of the war in Gaza in the summer of 2014. Mohamed Jabaly, a young man from the Gaza City, joins an ambulance crew as war approaches, looking for his place in a country under siege. While thousands of things are published on the recurring violence, the stories behind them remain hidden. Not this one. The ambulace team is led by captain Abu Marzouq who saved lives in many of Gaza's wars.

programme.title: Combat Forces
programme.desc: Artillery is known as the King of Battle and for over 100 years it has played a pivotal role in combat. In this fascinating episode we learn how artillery works, what ammunition it fires and how it plays an important role in modern combat. We join gunners preparing for deployment to Iraq and Afghanistan who are on exercise.

programme.title: A Gentleman Thief
programme.desc: Vincenzo Pipino is a thief, he was convicted and has done over 25 years in prison both in Italy and in the rest of Europe and has expiated his faults. The documentary tells the story of this last gentleman thief.

programme.title: Undercover Jihadi
programme.desc: Each time a young man leaves a quiet suburb to join ISIS, we are shocked. Why do they do it? How can they be stopped? And if they come back, what to do about them? These are the questions that drive Mubin Shaikh on his quest to stop potential jihadis. Mubin went from militant extremist to undercover operative. Now a Counter-Terrorism expert, he takes to the frontlines of the battle against violent extremism around the world.

programme.title: Echoes Of The Empire: Beyond Genghis
programme.desc: Mongolia: for most of us, it brings to mind Genghis Khan's mighty empire. But in the present day, there is also a rich culture in the nation that grew from the ashes of Genghis Khan's triumphs, and a complex history aside from the bloodshed and conquest. A stunning cinematic view of the country's past and present, from the remarkable evolution of the Mongol Empire to intimate portraits of today’s Mongolians.

programme.title: Combat Forces
programme.desc: In the Vietnam War the USAF discovered that 90% of their casualties occurred during pilots first 10 missions. So a specialized training exercise was developed to provide pilots with the same combat missions they could expect in their first 10 missions. The results are incredible.

programme.title: Immersion
programme.desc: The darkness, the muffled noises, holding your breath until the very last minute: this documentary plunges into the world of free diving. Lakes, rivers, oceans - the abyss is a source of fascination for Igor. Travelling from Switzerland to the world’s deepest blue hole in the Caribbean, Igor starts to compete and is crowned Swiss champion of free diving, descending to 82 metres.

programme.title: Still Tibet
programme.desc: Embarking on a deep journey through one of the most remote ethnically Tibetan areas of China's Sichuan Province, filmmaker Miguel Cano hitchhikes, motorbikes and takes to foot to reach parts of the region that usually go untouched by tourists. With incredible cinematography, he journeys throughout the holy region to discover those fighting to preserve their spiritual and national identity, exposing a vulnerable civilization that retains an extraordinary mystical essence. "She was moved to tears as she told me of her last twenty years far from home.. it was then I made the promise to this woman to go deep into Tibet, and return to tell the world what I saw." Whilst travelling in Nepal, American filmmaker Miguel Cano chanced upon an elderly Tibetan lady. Weathered and frail, she told him of her past; how years ago she was driven from her home by Chinese authorities, forced to live out her days alone in exile. Moved by her suffering, Cano vowed to visit the often-uncharted region and explore an ancient culture increasingly under threat. Alone and with no clear itinerary, Cano immerses himself in the customs and traditions of the Tibetan people; his only objective being to absorb the unique culture of the region. "I needed to let the path take me where it will", he explains. Hitching rides on the back of motorbikes and sleeping in mountaintop monasteries, Cano is welcomed by a people of immense warmth and charm. "Even though we could not talk to each other, it felt as if we always said so much... communication felt more honest than I had ever experienced." Largely isolated from the rest of society, the autonomous region remains the cradle of eastern Buddhism and spirituality, many of its ancient traditions still intact. However, as ​Cano discovers, the region is not purely a religious utopia. Despite the warmth of the Tibetan locals, he is harassed at every turn by an an overbearing and very visible Chinese police force, and the underlying tensions between Tibetans and their Chinese neighbours is notable throughout the region. Tibet remains under threat from the West as well as the East, and the arrival of consumer culture has brought with it a sharp increase in debris and waste: amongst the breathtaking hills and valleys are growing mountains of drinks cans, food packaging and refuse. "There is a complete lack of environmental awareness", Cano explains, "there's no infrastructure to dispose of this garbage".

programme.title: Unknown Distance
programme.desc: After five tours and ten years as a Marine Sniper, Sergeant Douglas Brown, alongside director and producer Gordon Clark, takes us on an emotional journey across America, documenting the powerful testimony of returning combat veterans - all trained with a deadly skill set, now rendered useless. How do these soldiers fit back into a society that supported them when they enlisted but became ambivalent when they returned?

programme.title: Far Away From Home
programme.desc: A group of children and adolescents, from different Latin American countries are living in shelters in Tijuana. They are all waiting for a response to their request for asylum to enter the USA. The wait is long and uncertain, they are childhoods on hold.

programme.desc: Today nuclear subs dominate the seas…yet their biggest threat is a diesel submarine. We learn more about why they are so lethal in the dark depths of the Norwegian Fiords while on a NATO exercise inside a modern diesel submarine.

programme.title: Banzai Switzerland
programme.desc: Someone in Japan is in love with Switzerland, its culture, its folklore and, more specifically: the Swiss alphorn! The Tamagawa Alphorn Club from Nanasawa, Japan, is travelling to Switzerland to attend the International Alphorn Festival in Nendaz at the end of July. Alphorn playing started to be known in Japan in the 80ies and is becoming more and more popular in the last decade among retired people, but not only. Shigetoshi Nakagawa, founder of the group and a forest expert, is one of the first people who started to play the instrument; he has instructed to build and play the Alphorn in numerous regions, among children and elderly people. Thousands of Alphorn Clubs have been born lately and more and more Japanese are being interested in Swiss folklore culture and Switzerland in general.

programme.title: Crimes Of The Future
programme.desc: Through conversations with an array of Norwegian writers, filmmakers, psychiatrists, artists and more, Izquierdo investigates the impact of both the film and novel on generations of Norwegian culture and artistic practice, while exploring how it could speak about what it means to be an artist today.

programme.desc: Abigail Child has been at the vanguard of experimental media since the 1980s. In her latest project, she offers viewers an eerie look into the present and future of AI, through the perspectives of scientists, entrepreneurs and a Black lesbian robot. Child’s thought-provoking film considers the emerging technology’s ethical and emotional implications, presenting a speculative, not-too-distant future grounded in sci-fi.

programme.title: Dreams From The Outback
programme.desc: The Kimberley in West Australia is home to various Aboriginal communities, where today most is in transition causing limbo and distress. Some has given up; others choose to fight both past and present demons to bring a change for the better to their people. In 'Dreams from the Outback' best friends Gabriel and Peter try to keep the ancient cultural traditions alive, with almost no support from the rest of their community. Felicity struggles to keep her family together after years of drinking and neglect and teeenagers Billy and Jordan are brothers who meet for the first time. The boys spend the days getting to know each other, exploring the outback and their culture.

programme.title: Combat Forces
programme.desc: Today nuclear subs dominate the seas…yet their biggest threat is a diesel submarine. The modern diesel submarine is capable of a wide range of capabilities and it is known for its incredible stealth. We learn more about why they are so lethal in the dark depths of the Norwegian Fiords while on a NATO exercise inside a modern diesel submarine.

programme.title: Banzai Switzerland
programme.desc: Someone in Japan is in love with Switzerland, its culture, its folklore and, more specifically: the Swiss alphorn! The Tamagawa Alphorn Club from Nanasawa, Japan, is travelling to Switzerland to attend the International Alphorn Festival in Nendaz at the end of July. Alphorn playing started to be known in Japan in the 80ies and is becoming more and more popular in the last decade among retired people, but not only. Shigetoshi Nakagawa, founder of the group and a forest expert, is one of the first people who started to play the instrument; he has instructed to build and play the Alphorn in numerous regions, among children and elderly people. Thousands of Alphorn Clubs have been born lately and more and more Japanese are being interested in Swiss folklore culture and Switzerland in general.

programme.title: Crimes Of The Future
programme.desc: Through conversations with an array of Norwegian writers, filmmakers, psychiatrists, artists and more, Izquierdo investigates the impact of both the film and novel on generations of Norwegian culture and artistic practice, while exploring how it could speak about what it means to be an artist today.

programme.title: Origin of the Species
programme.desc: Abigail Child has been at the vanguard of experimental media since the 1980s. In her latest project, she offers viewers an eerie look into the present and future of AI, through the perspectives of scientists, entrepreneurs and a Black lesbian robot. Child’s thought-provoking film considers the emerging technology’s ethical and emotional implications, presenting a speculative, not-too-distant future grounded in sci-fi.

programme.title: Combat Forces
programme.desc: Modern tanks are the equivalent of chariots on the battlefields of today. In Iraq and Afghanistan they are soldiers saviors or an enemy’s nightmare. We join tank crews from several nations as they train for deployment to overseas hotspots. This is the extreme edge of firepower!

programme.title: K2 and The Invisible Footmen
programme.desc: K2 is widely seen as the world's harshest mountain. Yet many indigenous porters make a living in its extreme conditions, carrying provisions for foreign climbing expeditions. Often risking their lives with only rudimentary equipment, they receive minimal pay for their efforts. Against a backdrop of breathtaking natural beauty, this cinematic doc explores the everyday courage and sacrifice of the men who call the 'Savage Mountain' their home.

programme.title: Out of the Dark
programme.desc: The extraordinary international effort to find and rescue 12 boys and their coach from a remote cave in northern Thailand was watched closely by millions. Four Corners documents this wonderful and tragic tale from the day the boys first disappeared until the joyous moment the last person left the cave.

programme.title: Up In Smoke
programme.desc: Up In Smoke follows British scientist Mike Hands, who has laboured for 25 years to find a solution to replacing slash & burn agriculture in equatorial rainforests. This is a film about a struggle for our future. About the heroic, sometimes quixotic, mission of Mike Hands to get people to understand his revolutionary method.

programme.title: The Film Justifies The Means
programme.desc: Inside our dark editing rooms, we discover images filmed by a generation of filmmakers that reveal the reality of a country in conflict. Five decades later, we recover fragments of a cinematic memory that refuses to disappear.

programme.title: Combat Forces
programme.desc: Silent, covert, deadly; they are every battle commander’s secret weapon. Snipers are the long-range killers on the battlefield. We travel to several renowned sniper schools to see them train; learn about their advanced technology weapons and unique field craft.

programme.title: The Huddle
programme.desc: Though separated by a stretch of sea, Glasgow and Belfast share elements of political, sporting and religious culture rooted in the difficult, unresolved events faced by the Irish community during the twentieth century. The Huddle tells the stories of two Irish communities brought together by a devotion to the Celtic Football Club, and a shared faith in football. Exploring the contradictions between two cities facing radical ideological divides yet brought together by full stadiums, these are the interwoven and personal accounts of journalists, musicians, political militants, IRA fighters—all united by their love of football—on what it means to be Irish.

programme.title: Black And Arab
programme.desc: Nareeman Dosa - Saudi-born, and of Sudanese heritage, - grew up in the Arab world experiencing the casual racism that most Black Arabs face. In Black and Arab, she visits Tunisia, the first Arab country to have made racial discrimination a criminal offence, embarking on a journey to explore whether the law can alter deep-rooted prejudice, as well as speaking to other Black Arabs for whom racism has been a sadly pervasive part of their existence.

programme.title: Sheltered
programme.desc: In the busy world of the animal shelter, the loving bond between humans and animals is strained by the endless stream of abandoned cats, dogs, and rabbits. Pets are life companions - but for some, they are dispensable. With care and training by the passionate employees and dedicated volunteers, the hopeful animals are rehabilitated. Not every story has a happy ending, but the team fights on - even for the biggest misfits of them all.

programme.title: A Man & His Trumpet: The Leroy Jones Story
programme.desc: Follow the fascinating life story of trumpeter Leroy Jones. From the projects of New Orleans, Jones goes on to lead the brass band revival, and eventually catches the ear of Harry Connick Jr., and becomes known worldwide.

programme.title: Combat Forces
programme.desc: House-to-house combat is one of the most brutal and intense types of land warfare. Recent conflicts in Bosnia, Somalia and Iraq have reinforced the need for training in this specialized skill set. At urban warfare training facilities throughout the world, we learn first-hand what it takes to survive!

programme.title: Turning a Blind Eye
programme.desc: In October 2019 an unthinkable tragedy hit the peaceful village of Jura in Switzerland. Christophe Keller slit his wife Mélanie's throat before cutting his own. The crime shocked the whole country. What had happened between this couple, living a seemingly ordinary life with their three children? Each year, nearly 90,000 women are killed by their partner or ex-partner throughout the world. Could more have been done to save Mélanie?

programme.title: Alaska Long Hunters
programme.desc: A true life adventure set in 60's Alaska, Documenting a young pilots life who through it all, meets his creator God and finds life's true meaning. Based on the book "Last of the Long Hunters" by Mark Rose (2015) This story records the life of a young pilot flying in Alaska's Frontier Arctic. You'll experience the front seat thrills of bush planes and helicopters operating in the most dangerous conditions on Earth. Flying in minus 60 temperatures and horrific storms, airborne among the magnificent mountains, glaciers and rivers that only Alaska has to offer. Once you've read this volume you'll not be satisfied until you visit Alaska yourself. Includes true-life experiences of accidents, comradeship, humor, heartbreaks and life in Frontier Alaska, gone forever when dismantled into parks and native lands in the 1970's.

programme.title: The Time of Their Lives
programme.desc: The ultimate coming-of-age movie. With a combined age of almost 300, Hetty, Rose and Alison love to share their concerns on everything from terrorism and global warming to sex, death and the meaning of life. The Time of Their Lives reveals the everyday mystery of how very old people experience life and the intense challenges that old age brings. Like first-hand witnesses reporting back from the edge of their own mortality, Hetty, Rose and Alison tell us things which are never spoken of.

programme.title: An Italian Youth
programme.desc: Mathieu Volpe, film director invites us to follow Sokuro over a long period of time. Through a few key moments in the love story between Sokuro and Nassira, he offers another perspective on economic migration, which through this embodied representation takes on a more intimate quality. Regret, nostalgia and lack are the side effects of these reluctant exiles, done out of necessity rather than desire, that are too often kept in the shadows. By offering faces and bodies to a current topic, by embodying it and taking the time to explore its complexity, documentary cinema allows to deepen our reflection; Sokuro and Nassira’s contradictory yet profoundly human aspirations as well as their story is superimposed over the media narratives around the subject, enriching and humanising them.

Once you've read this volume you'll not be satisfied until you visit Alaska yourself. Includes true-life experiences of accidents, comradeship, humor, heartbreaks and life in Frontier Alaska, gone forever when dismantled into parks and native lands in the 1970's.

programme.title: The Time of Their Lives
programme.desc: The ultimate coming-of-age movie. With a combined age of almost 300, Hetty, Rose and Alison love to share their concerns on everything from terrorism and global warming to sex, death and the meaning of life. The Time of Their Lives reveals the everyday mystery of how very old people experience life and the intense challenges that old age brings. Like first-hand witnesses reporting back from the edge of their own mortality, Hetty, Rose and Alison tell us things which are never spoken of.

programme.title: An Italian Youth
programme.desc: Mathieu Volpe, film director invites us to follow Sokuro over a long period of time. Through a few key moments in the love story between Sokuro and Nassira, he offers another perspective on economic migration, which through this embodied representation takes on a more intimate quality. Regret, nostalgia and lack are the side effects of these reluctant exiles, done out of necessity rather than desire, that are too often kept in the shadows. By offering faces and bodies to a current topic, by embodying it and taking the time to explore its complexity, documentary cinema allows to deepen our reflection; Sokuro and Nassira’s contradictory yet profoundly human aspirations as well as their story is superimposed over the media narratives around the subject, enriching and humanising them.

programme.title: Combat Forces
programme.desc: Artillery is known as the King of Battle and for over 100 years it has played a pivotal role in combat. In this fascinating episode we learn how artillery works, what ammunition it fires and how it plays an important role in modern combat. We join gunners preparing for deployment to Iraq and Afghanistan who are on exercise.

programme.title: A Gentleman Thief
programme.desc: Vincenzo Pipino is a thief, he was convicted and has done over 25 years in prison both in Italy and in the rest of Europe and has expiated his faults. The documentary tells the story of this last gentleman thief.

programme.title: Undercover Jihadi
programme.desc: Each time a young man leaves a quiet suburb to join ISIS, we are shocked. Why do they do it? How can they be stopped? And if they come back, what to do about them? These are the questions that drive Mubin Shaikh on his quest to stop potential jihadis. Mubin went from militant extremist to undercover operative. Now a Counter-Terrorism expert, he takes to the frontlines of the battle against violent extremism around the world.

programme.title: Echoes Of The Empire: Beyond Genghis
programme.desc: Mongolia: for most of us, it brings to mind Genghis Khan's mighty empire. But in the present day, there is also a rich culture in the nation that grew from the ashes of Genghis Khan's triumphs, and a complex history aside from the bloodshed and conquest. A stunning cinematic view of the country's past and present, from the remarkable evolution of the Mongol Empire to intimate portraits of today’s Mongolians.

programme.title: Ambulance
programme.desc: When a talented young filmmaker tells the story of his country with compassion, beauty, and warmth in an honest, straight and raw first-person account of the war in Gaza in the summer of 2014. Mohamed Jabaly, a young man from the Gaza City, joins an ambulance crew as war approaches, looking for his place in a country under siege. While thousands of things are published on the recurring violence, the stories behind them remain hidden. Not this one. The ambulace team is led by captain Abu Marzouq who saved lives in many of Gaza's wars.

programme.title: Combat Forces
programme.desc: In the Vietnam War the USAF discovered that 90% of their casualties occurred during pilots first 10 missions. So a specialized training exercise was developed to provide pilots with the same combat missions they could expect in their first 10 missions. The results are incredible.

programme.title: Immersion
programme.desc: The darkness, the muffled noises, holding your breath until the very last minute: this documentary plunges into the world of free diving. Lakes, rivers, oceans - the abyss is a source of fascination for Igor. Travelling from Switzerland to the world’s deepest blue hole in the Caribbean, Igor starts to compete and is crowned Swiss champion of free diving, descending to 82 metres.

programme.title: Still Tibet
programme.desc: Embarking on a deep journey through one of the most remote ethnically Tibetan areas of China's Sichuan Province, filmmaker Miguel Cano hitchhikes, motorbikes and takes to foot to reach parts of the region that usually go untouched by tourists. With incredible cinematography, he journeys throughout the holy region to discover those fighting to preserve their spiritual and national identity, exposing a vulnerable civilization that retains an extraordinary mystical essence. "She was moved to tears as she told me of her last twenty years far from home.. it was then I made the promise to this woman to go deep into Tibet, and return to tell the world what I saw." Whilst travelling in Nepal, American filmmaker Miguel Cano chanced upon an elderly Tibetan lady. Weathered and frail, she told him of her past; how years ago she was driven from her home by Chinese authorities, forced to live out her days alone in exile. Moved by her suffering, Cano vowed to visit the often-uncharted region and explore an ancient culture increasingly under threat. Alone and with no clear itinerary, Cano immerses himself in the customs and traditions of the Tibetan people; his only objective being to absorb the unique culture of the region. "I needed to let the path take me where it will", he explains. Hitching rides on the back of motorbikes and sleeping in mountaintop monasteries, Cano is welcomed by a people of immense warmth and charm. "Even though we could not talk to each other, it felt as if we always said so much... communication felt more honest than I had ever experienced." Largely isolated from the rest of society, the autonomous region remains the cradle of eastern Buddhism and spirituality, many of its ancient traditions still intact. However, as ​Cano discovers, the region is not purely a religious utopia. Despite the warmth of the Tibetan locals, he is harassed at every turn by an an overbearing and very visible Chinese police force, and the underlying tensions between Tibetans and their Chinese neighbours is notable throughout the region. Tibet remains under threat from the West as well as the East, and the arrival of consumer culture has brought with it a sharp increase in debris and waste: amongst the breathtaking hills and valleys are growing mountains of drinks cans, food packaging and refuse. "There is a complete lack of environmental awareness", Cano explains, "there's no infrastructure to dispose of this garbage".

programme.title: Unknown Distance
programme.desc: After five tours and ten years as a Marine Sniper, Sergeant Douglas Brown, alongside director and producer Gordon Clark, takes us on an emotional journey across America, documenting the powerful testimony of returning combat veterans - all trained with a deadly skill set, now rendered useless. How do these soldiers fit back into a society that supported them when they enlisted but became ambivalent when they returned?

programme.title: Far Away From Home
programme.desc: A group of children and adolescents, from different Latin American countries are living in shelters in Tijuana. They are all waiting for a response to their request for asylum to enter the USA. The wait is long and uncertain, they are childhoods on hold.

programme.title: Combat Forces
programme.desc: Hand-to-hand combat, it is every soldiers greatest fear. At the Army Combatives School in Fort Benning, Georgia, they teach soldiers how to fight to survive. Teach them skills that are beyond UFC…skills that kill!

programme.title: The Silent Scream
programme.desc: Since thirty years the data on the glaciers melting are truly alarming .There are men who have dedicated most of their lives to glaciers, photographing, measuring and monitoring them. This documentary collects their testimonies, bringing more awareness about the current state of glaciers and our mountains

programme.title: A Russian Fairytale
programme.desc: Following the break up of the Soviet union, a gang of children from broken homes made a new life together inside the derelict buildings of a once secret weapons manufacturing city. In their childhood innocence, they thought they were living a fairytale dream of freedom, but with starvation and sub zero temperatures crippling their health, reality soon hit home. Despite their efforts to care for one another, three members of their group died. For the survivors: they must try against hopeless odds to turn their lives around.

programme.title: Angel of Nanjing
programme.desc: The Yangtze River Bridge in Nanjing is the most popular place in the world to commit suicide, with over 5 attempts per week. For the past 11 years, blue-collar worker Chen Si has been patrolling this bridge every day, watching out for desperate people who've gone there to end their lives. With no formal training, he has saved over 300 people since he began; earning him the nickname the 'Angel of Nanjing'.

programme.title: The Good Death
programme.desc:
Janette is terminally ill and wants to die in a dignified way. Muscular dystrophy, the illness that Janette suffers from, has affected her family for generations. Janette's mother was wheelchair bound for decades, a prisoner in her own body. Janette refuses to wait for death in unbearable pain and opts for physician-assisted suicide. Before leaving on her last journey she has to explain her intention to her family members and close friends. Her son Simon has also inherited this illness and, therefore, has much more sympathy for her decision than his sister Bridget. If no cure for this illness is found, he will face the same decision process as his mother. Both children try to convince Janette to postpone her death. Do we own our life or does it own us?
The film uses feature film techniques, and engaging characters and their stories interwoven with Janette’s testament.

programme.title: Destination
programme.desc: Join John Plaskett as he heads to Europe’s second biggest music festival – EXIT. Held in the impressive grounds of the Petrovaradin Fortress in Serbia’s Novi Sad, the festival is a hub for music lovers. But outside of the party hours, what else is there to do?

programme.title: Into Water & Beyond
programme.desc: Queenstown in alive all year round, from adventure and adrenalin activities to everything outdoors - this place has got it all…

programme.title: Discover China
programme.desc: At the turn of the century, a Child-Emperor ascended to the throne of the Chinese Qing Dynasty. Emperor Pu-Yi’s Reign was short lived and mired with treason, corruption and external influences. After abdicating his throne, Pu Yi knew his days in the imperial palace were numbered. Questions of his survival as a commoner began to trouble his mind. Upon looking at the wealth of priceless artifacts collected over 500 years of imperial reign, Pu Yi began plotting ways to smuggle these riches out. However, Pu Yi was not alone. Discover China brings you the story of how the precious treasures of the Imperial City disappeared from the capital palace, and where some reside today.

programme.title: Discover China
programme.desc: No one could have dreamed that from this baby boy, born to a noble family on a financial and social decline, would grow one of China's most influential, iconic and important historical figures. From his early days, mimicking the religious rituals, to a young man who traveled throughout China, advising kings and emperors on how to rule, the man ultimately became a living legend, as his teachings and his memory are still revered and worshipped to this day in modern China. Discover China follows in the footsteps of one of China's most important cultural heroes, Confucius.

programme.title: Discover China
programme.desc: At the foot of Tai Mountain sits an enigma – it is a temple, dedicated to the god of Tai Mountain, yet it bears a striking resemblance to an imperial palace. The secrets behind this grand and lavish temple lie in a ceremonial farce, carried out by a brazen and ambitious emperor, who would not heed his country's desperate situation and instead tried to bolster his status as sole ruler. As time passed, and this emperor's remains turned to ashes, all that remains from this fantastic episode in China's history is this stunning shrine. Discover China uncovers the secrets of this temple and the ceremonies which brought it to life, in The Emperor's Fantasy.

programme.title: Discover China
programme.desc: A startling scientific discovery has changed the face of evolutionary science. A single tooth shook the scientific community. The secrets the skulls of ancient ape-men, found in a Beijing suburb potentially held the key to the missing link in Human evolution. Dozens of experts formed an international team in an attempt to uncover the tracks of this specimen, and find out more about its habits. On the eve of war, these skulls suddenly disappeared off the face of the earth, leaving no trace. As the history unfolds, scientists debated the origin of the Peking ape-man, as the world wonders where his remains might be.

programme.title: Discover China
programme.desc: It is one of China's most revered mountains. A religious center to this day for numerous sects of Chinese Buddhism, Emei Mountain was once the battle ground where Buddhism once clashed with one of China's leading religions at the time – Taoism. From the celestial revelations that led to the dawn of this religion on Emei mountain, through the legends of the White Snake, and to the religious ceremonies that brought an Emperor his heir, Emei mountain remains one of China's most illustrious religious hubs, where pilgrimages take place to this day. Discover China unveils the secrets behind Buddhism's rise to power, in the Tides between Taoism & Buddhism.

From the celestial revelations that led to the dawn of this religion on Emei mountain, through the legends of the White Snake, and to the religious ceremonies that brought an Emperor his heir, Emei mountain remains one of China's most illustrious religious hubs, where pilgrimages take place to this day. Discover China unveils the secrets behind Buddhism's rise to power, in the Tides between Taoism & Buddhism.

programme.title: Discover China
programme.desc: The suicide of a woman shocked an entire village. It jolted an entire province, and word of her death even reached the imperial court. Upon hearing of the reasons behind this woman’s untimely death, the emperor decreed a magnificent arch be built in her memory, earning her family, her village and her province an honor of the highest degree. These beautiful arches, which dot China’s scenery, are the culmination of a culture founded on the remembrance of those who achieved a higher moral status than the rest of society, those who were chaste and remained pure, even in their deaths. Discover China passes on the story of Memorial Arches.

programme.title: Discover China
programme.desc: At the turn of the century, a Child-Emperor ascended to the throne of the Chinese Qing Dynasty. Emperor Pu-Yi’s Reign was short lived and mired with treason, corruption and external influences. After abdicating his throne, Pu Yi knew his days in the imperial palace were numbered. Questions of his survival as a commoner began to trouble his mind. Upon looking at the wealth of priceless artifacts collected over 500 years of imperial reign, Pu Yi began plotting ways to smuggle these riches out. However, Pu Yi was not alone. Discover China brings you the story of how the precious treasures of the Imperial City disappeared from the capital palace, and where some reside today.

programme.desc: No one could have dreamed that from this baby boy, born to a noble family on a financial and social decline, would grow one of China's most influential, iconic and important historical figures. Discover China follows in the footsteps of one of China's most important cultural heroes, Confucius.

programme.title: Discover China
programme.desc: At the foot of Tai Mountain sits an enigma – it is a temple, dedicated to the god of Tai Mountain, yet it bears a striking resemblance to an imperial palace. The secrets behind this grand and lavish temple lie in a ceremonial farce, carried out by a brazen and ambitious emperor, who would not heed his country's desperate situation and instead tried to bolster his status as sole ruler. As time passed, and this emperor's remains turned to ashes, all that remains from this fantastic episode in China's history is this stunning shrine. Discover China uncovers the secrets of this temple and the ceremonies which brought it to life, in The Emperor's Fantasy.

programme.title: Discover China
programme.desc: A startling scientific discovery has changed the face of evolutionary science. A single tooth shook the scientific community. The secrets the skulls of ancient ape-men, found in a Beijing suburb potentially held the key to the missing link in Human evolution. Dozens of experts formed an international team in an attempt to uncover the tracks of this specimen, and find out more about its habits. On the eve of war, these skulls suddenly disappeared off the face of the earth, leaving no trace. As the history unfolds, scientists debated the origin of the Peking ape-man, as the world wonders where his remains might be.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E24 - The Queen Her True Story
programme.desc: 一位非凡女性和她驚人的生活故事。
programme.sub-title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E24 - The Queen Her True Story

programme.title: Wardens - S04:E07 - Cheeseheads
programme.desc: Esta semana, los vigilantes de caza están en la búsqueda de cazadores furtivos y de personas que infringen las leyes de caza, con algo de ayuda de señuelos a tamaño real y consejos que llaman los lugareños a la línea directa TIP-MONT.

programme.title: Wardens - S04:E08 - Three Fifty Seven
programme.desc: 遊戲管理員正在執行搜索，可疑的偷獵者在季節開始之前獵殺了一隻鹿。與此同時，另一位管理員帶著他的兒子去狩獵，因為他的兒子獲得了一個稀有的駝鹿標籤。

programme.title: Dropped - S07:E01 - Survival Mode
programme.desc: Los hermanos Chris y Casey Keefer reflexionan sobre algunos de los mejores momentos de las dos primeras temporadas de Dropped. Los temas incluyen las cacerías individuales más memorables de los hermanos y cómo Dropped ha evolucionado a lo largo de los años.

programme.title: Dropped - S07:E02 - Game Plan
programme.desc: Con el campamento base montado y el frío arreciando, Chris y Casey deben encontrar comida... rápido. Sus niveles de energía se están agotando a medida que comienzan su caza de alces. A medida que pasa el tiempo, los hermanos deben pensar bien para encontrar comida... o arriesgarse a pasar hambre.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S04:E01 - The Last Crusade of Indiana Terry
programme.desc: 這些家伙測試《印第安納·瓊斯與最後的十字軍東征》的幾個場景。
programme.sub-title: Hollywood Weapons - S04:E01 - The Last Crusade of Indiana Terry

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S04:E02 - Equalizing Terry
programme.desc: 特里和拉里將測試丹佐·華盛頓的《平衡者》電影中的三個場景。特里能否像丹佐一樣酷，利用丙烷罐和微波爐創造爆炸，使用釘槍消滅壞人，或獲得閃光彈點燃滿是烘焙產品的房間？

programme.title: The New Frontier - S03:E05 - Juno, Cassini and Beyond
programme.desc: The Cassini space craft has completed its mission over Saturn, Juno has reached its target and has commenced its scientific observations of the giant planet Jupiter. and The New Horizons speeds on it its next encounter at the edge of the solar system.
programme.sub-title: The New Frontier - S03:E05 - Juno, Cassini and Beyond

programme.title: The New Frontier - S03:E06 - Sling Shot
programme.desc: El envío de sondas a través del sistema solar es el sueño de los matemáticos y la pesadilla de los ingenieros, que lanzan sondas alrededor de otros planetas para llegar a su destino.
programme.sub-title: The New Frontier - S03:E06 - Sling Shot

programme.title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E01 - Introduction to Military Special Forces
programme.desc: “Special Operations” are special divisions of military, police or intelligence services that are highly qualified in specific areas of urban warfare and in a variety of special weapons and technology.
programme.sub-title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E01 - Introduction to Military Special Forces

programme.title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E02 - Introduction to Police Special Operations
programme.desc: A medida que la guerra ha ido evolucionando, muchas técnicas y tecnologías militares han sido adaptadas para su uso en entornos urbanos por unidades policiales de todo el mundo. Este episodio ofrece a los espectadores una perspectiva íntima de lo que se siente al estar "dentro de las cabezas" del personal especial de la policía, y de cómo su uso de estrategias y equipos de estilo militar les permite salvar vidas. Desde el control de disturbios en Sudáfrica y las lecciones aprendidas de sus excesos, hasta la creación por parte del jefe de policía de Los Ángeles, Robert Gates, de un equipo policial de élite S.W.A.T., CQB mostrará cómo, en los últimos 30 años, la lucha contra la delincuencia urbana ha evolucionado hasta convertirse en un escenario militar, en el que ambos bandos utilizan armamento y tácticas cada vez más complejos.
programme.sub-title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E02 - Introduction to Police Special Operations

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E06 - Princess Diana's Legacy
programme.desc: 反思戴安娜公主的遺產，這個節目深入探討了她在突然去世後留下的遺產——她對孩子們、皇室以及愛她的人留下的印象。年輕的王子們在她的葬禮上因其舉止贏得了讚譽，但許多人質疑他們與查爾斯王子的關係未來將會如何發展。
programme.sub-title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E06 - Princess Diana's Legacy

programme.desc: 一位非凡女性和她驚人的生活故事。
programme.sub-title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E24 - The Queen Her True Story

programme.title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E03 - Russian Army in Chechnya
programme.desc: Tras la caída de la Unión Soviética, muchos países siguieron en disputa a principios de los noventa, a pesar de la independencia de Europa del Este. En 1994 estalló un amargo conflicto entre las fuerzas del movimiento independentista checheno y el ejército regular ruso. A pesar de la abrumadora cantidad de efectivos, armamento y apoyo aéreo, las fuerzas rusas fueron incapaces de establecer un control permanente efectivo sobre la zona montañosa debido a las numerosas y exitosas incursiones de la guerrilla chechena. Los artefactos explosivos improvisados fueron uno de los métodos más eficaces empleados en estas desastrosas incursiones y fueron el telón de fondo de muchos escenarios de batallas cuerpo a cuerpo intercambiadas entre ambos bandos.
programme.sub-title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E03 - Russian Army in Chechnya

programme.title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E04 - SAS in Northern Ireland
programme.desc: La historia del legado colonial del Imperio Británico en Irlanda del Norte es bien conocida en todo el mundo, pero hay una historia en gran parte no contada de los tiroteos entre y batallas cuerpo a cuerpo intercambiados entre el IRA provisional, el ejército británico y el SAS de élite. Aunque el IRA empleó a menudo técnicas "terroristas" dentro de la ciudad de Londres y en el territorio continental de Inglaterra, no se habla mucho de las técnicas de guerra de guerrillas del Servicio Aéreo Especial británico en Irlanda del Norte desde el comienzo de este conflicto. En este episodio examinaremos cómo la historia del Servicio Aéreo Especial afectó a la formación de todas las fuerzas de élite posteriores y cómo las batallas cuerpo a cuerpo en Irlanda del Norte a finales de la década de 1970 hasta el milenio dieron forma tanto a las fuerzas especiales como a los métodos de resistencia.
programme.sub-title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E04 - SAS in Northern Ireland

programme.title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E05 - Delta Prison Rescue Operation
programme.desc: En 1989, el agente de la CIA Kurt Muse fue encarcelado en la tristemente célebre Cárcel Modelo de Panamá por su papel en la organización de transmisiones de radio contra el dictador Manuel Noriega. En diciembre de ese año, un grupo de élite de la Fuerza Delta de Estados Unidos irrumpió en el tejado de la prisión y comenzó una de las operaciones de combate cuerpo a cuerpo más audaces de la historia. Desde el dramático accidente de helicóptero en el que resultaron heridos varios operadores Delta hasta la extracción de todo el equipo por parte de la 5ª División de Infantería, se trata de material de primera para el análisis CQB. En este episodio, CQB recrea la incursión, centrándose en los reflejos "sub-segundos" del equipo Delta Force desde el momento en que entraron en la prisión hasta su extracción desde el tejado de la prisión por un helicóptero MH-6 "Little Bird".
programme.sub-title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E05 - Delta Prison Rescue Operation

programme.title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E06 - Snipers and Scout
programme.desc: Die Joint Task Force Two (JTF 2) ist die Eliteeinheit der kanadischen Streitkräfte für Sondereinsätze, die für ein breites Spektrum von Missionen zuständig ist, darunter Terrorismusbekämpfung und bewaffnete Unterstützung für andere Regierungsstellen. Die äußerst geheimnisvolle JTF 2 und ihr Vorgänger, das Canadian Airborne Regiment, sind in Krisengebieten auf der ganzen Welt eingesetzt worden, von Haiti bis Bosnien. In dieser Folge geht es um die legendären JTF-Scharfschützenteams und ihren Einsatz in Afghanistan an der Seite der britischen SAS und der US-amerikanischen Delta Force am "scharfen Ende der Lanze". In einem Buch eines ehemaligen JTF-Mitglieds wird erklärt, wie 2006 sowohl das Pentagon als auch das britische Außenministerium die entscheidende Rolle der JTF 2 bei der Rettung des britischen und kanadischen Christian Peacemaker Teams, das im Irak als Geisel festgehalten wurde, hervorhoben. Die FN P90, eine einzigartige persönliche Verteidigungswaffe, die von JTF 2-Soldaten und Sonderpolizisten auf der ganzen Welt verwendet wird, wird in diesem Programm besonders hervorgehoben.
programme.sub-title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E06 - Snipers and Scout

programme.desc: ¿Sabes en qué lugar del mundo se encuentra el último glaciar virgen? ¿Dónde está la cascada más alta y la más pequeña? ¿Qué desierto es el más árido o el más grande? ¿Le gustaría saber dónde están las montañas más inaccesibles, el punto más bajo de los océanos o los grandes desiertos de sal? programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S01:E02 - Naturally Dramatic
programme.desc: Este episodio describe el mayor milagro de la naturaleza que pudo ser creado por el cerebro humano. El monstruo del lago Ness. Parece que no existe, pero miles de visitantes siguen viniendo a ver el encantador lago y a escuchar historias sobre él. No sólo Nessi, sino las tierras altas escocesas son el milagro de la naturaleza.Luego visitamos rápidamente Andalucía y nos quitamos el sombrero ante las majestuosas montañas de Sierra Nevada.El lago más profundo del mundo se encuentra en Siberia. Hablaremos del Baikal, el milagro natural de Rusia.

programme.desc: Explore the exciting and intriguing life of the future king, Prince William, in this engaging documentary.
programme.sub-title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E26 - Prince William A Royal Portrait

programme.title: Wardens - S04:E13 - 700 Yards
programme.desc: 喬·甘比克在蒙大拿州的迪爾洛奇巡邏，凱恩·庫卡嘗試從冰中救援一隻生病的公鹿。

programme.title: Wardens - S04:E14 - Sullivan Hill
programme.desc: It's elk hunting season in Montana, and Bryan Golie is keeping an eye out for any hunters acting suspiciously. Meanwhile, Paul Luepke is dealing with two hunters who shot mule deer does without having the right permits.

programme.title: Dropped - S07:E07 - Motherly Love
programme.desc: Tras semanas intentando sobrevivir en Saskatchewan, Chris y Casey aún no han matado ningún animal de caza mayor. El tiempo se agota a medida que los osos empiezan a hibernar. La fuerza de voluntad mental se agota. Pero un mensaje de vuelta a casa lo cambia todo.

programme.title: Dropped - S07:E08 - Refuelled
programme.desc: Un giro en los acontecimientos levanta el ánimo de los hermanos, pero crea un enorme obstáculo que deben superar a medida que se adentran en una nueva carrera contra el reloj.Chris y Casey reflexionan sobre los retos a los que se han enfrentado hasta ahora, y los desafíos que aún tienen por delante.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S04:E07 - RED-ish
programme.desc: 糟糕的笑話、中式食品、低車和RPG，使這一集更加有趣。家伙們終於測試了布魯斯·威利斯（Bruce Willis）電影《RED》中長久以來請求的時刻。一些子彈在煎鍋里？麵包車上的迷你槍？拉里將如何安全地進行這些測試？

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S04:E08 - MacSchappert
programme.desc: 大家最喜歡的智慧型人物 MacGyver 面臨考驗。來自原系列和重啟版本的一些內容。無論如何，Terry 看起來很棒。就像任何 MacGyver 集數，生命岌岌可危，時間不等人。

programme.title: The New Frontier - S04:E01 - The Cryoshere
programme.desc: La misión conjunta "BepiColombo" de JAXA y ESA está a punto de ser lanzada. El objetivo es Mercurio, que ha sido descuidado durante demasiado tiempo por los programas mundiales de exploración espacial. Esta misión arrojará nueva luz sobre este extraño y diminuto mundo.
programme.sub-title: The New Frontier - S04:E01 - The Cryoshere

programme.title: The New Frontier - S04:E02 - Set Course for the Heart of the Sun
programme.desc: La misión Parker Solar Probe de la NASA está en camino y será seguida en breve por la Solar probe Mission de Europa. Ninguna nave espacial ha viajado antes tan rápido ni tan cerca de una estrella. La esperanza es desvelar el origen de los vientos solares que nos afectan aquí en la Tierra.
programme.sub-title: The New Frontier - S04:E02 - Set Course for the Heart of the Sun

programme.title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E07 - S.W.A.T.
programme.desc: En 1968, se estaba desarrollando una nueva forma de policía militar en una zona rural al norte de Los Ángeles. El Departamento de Policía de Los Ángeles envió a un observador a esta unidad, y éste, a su vez, transmitió sus conocimientos al Departamento de Policía de Los Ángeles. Esto contribuyó al desarrollo del primer equipo de Armas y Tácticas Especiales (S.W.A.T.) del departamento. Este episodio de CQB hace un recorrido histórico para examinar cómo este incidente afectó y cambió las tácticas policiales en todo el mundo. Utilizando el característico análisis de "sub-segundos" de CQB, el programa también examina cómo los equipos policiales S.W.A.T. se entrenan, planifican y equipan para los retos del combate urbano. La dramatización de un asedio de los S.W.A.T. a un piso franco de una banda en la década de 1980 muestra el complicado reto de proteger a personas inocentes que podrían quedar atrapadas en la línea de fuego, así como los detalles del régimen de entrenamiento de la brigada, su forma de comunicarse y el equipo especial que utilizaban.

programme.title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E08 - Hunting Sarajevo Snipers
programme.desc: La guerra de Bosnia fue un acontecimiento extraordinariamente complejo, con muchos niveles de participación militar, incluidas fuerzas de la OTAN, ejércitos nacionales, fuerzas paramilitares irregulares, revolucionarios muyahidines, empresas de seguridad privadas y personal de inteligencia internacional. Una táctica en particular infundió temor en los corazones de militares y civiles por igual: el uso de francotiradores situados en edificios altos. Esta edición de CQB investiga esta técnica de combate específica y cómo fue contrarrestada por las fuerzas contrarias. El programa lleva a los telespectadores al interior de una "guarida de francotiradores" y explica por qué las fuerzas rebeldes utilizaron con tanto éxito esta táctica y cómo evolucionaron las técnicas militares tradicionales para combatirla.
programme.sub-title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E08 - Hunting Sarajevo Snipers

programme.title: Diana: In Search of Happiness
programme.desc: 體驗對戴安娜公主的深入了解，這位20世紀的非凡女性。包含獨特的訪談和感人的片段，這幅肖像捕捉了她通往名聲的驚人之旅，以及她克服幾乎每天遭遇的情感和身體挑戰的能力。

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S04:E07 - RED-ish
programme.desc: 糟糕的笑話、中式食品、低車和RPG，使這一集更加有趣。家伙們終於測試了布魯斯·威利斯（Bruce Willis）電影《RED》中長久以來請求的時刻。一些子彈在煎鍋里？麵包車上的迷你槍？拉里將如何安全地進行這些測試？

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S04:E08 - MacSchappert
programme.desc: 大家最喜歡的智慧型人物 MacGyver 面臨考驗。來自原系列和重啟版本的一些內容。無論如何，Terry 看起來很棒。就像任何 MacGyver 集數，生命岌岌可危，時間不等人。

programme.title: The New Frontier - S04:E01 - The Cryoshere
programme.desc: La misión conjunta "BepiColombo" de JAXA y ESA está a punto de ser lanzada. El objetivo es Mercurio, que ha sido descuidado durante demasiado tiempo por los programas mundiales de exploración espacial. Esta misión arrojará nueva luz sobre este extraño y diminuto mundo.
programme.sub-title: The New Frontier - S04:E01 - The Cryoshere

programme.title: The New Frontier - S04:E02 - Set Course for the Heart of the Sun
programme.desc: La misión Parker Solar Probe de la NASA está en camino y será seguida en breve por la Solar probe Mission de Europa. Ninguna nave espacial ha viajado antes tan rápido ni tan cerca de una estrella. La esperanza es desvelar el origen de los vientos solares que nos afectan aquí en la Tierra.
programme.sub-title: The New Frontier - S04:E02 - Set Course for the Heart of the Sun

programme.title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E07 - S.W.A.T.
programme.desc: En 1968, se estaba desarrollando una nueva forma de policía militar en una zona rural al norte de Los Ángeles. El Departamento de Policía de Los Ángeles envió a un observador a esta unidad, y éste, a su vez, transmitió sus conocimientos al Departamento de Policía de Los Ángeles. Esto contribuyó al desarrollo del primer equipo de Armas y Tácticas Especiales (S.W.A.T.) del departamento. Este episodio de CQB hace un recorrido histórico para examinar cómo este incidente afectó y cambió las tácticas policiales en todo el mundo. Utilizando el característico análisis de "sub-segundos" de CQB, el programa también examina cómo los equipos policiales S.W.A.T. se entrenan, planifican y equipan para los retos del combate urbano. La dramatización de un asedio de los S.W.A.T. a un piso franco de una banda en la década de 1980 muestra el complicado reto de proteger a personas inocentes que podrían quedar atrapadas en la línea de fuego, así como los detalles del régimen de entrenamiento de la brigada, su forma de comunicarse y el equipo especial que utilizaban.

programme.title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E08 - Hunting Sarajevo Snipers
programme.desc: La guerra de Bosnia fue un acontecimiento extraordinariamente complejo, con muchos niveles de participación militar, incluidas fuerzas de la OTAN, ejércitos nacionales, fuerzas paramilitares irregulares, revolucionarios muyahidines, empresas de seguridad privadas y personal de inteligencia internacional. Una táctica en particular infundió temor en los corazones de militares y civiles por igual: el uso de francotiradores situados en edificios altos. Esta edición de CQB investiga esta técnica de combate específica y cómo fue contrarrestada por las fuerzas contrarias. El programa lleva a los telespectadores al interior de una "guarida de francotiradores" y explica por qué las fuerzas rebeldes utilizaron con tanto éxito esta táctica y cómo evolucionaron las técnicas militares tradicionales para combatirla.
programme.sub-title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E08 - Hunting Sarajevo Snipers

programme.desc: 特里和拉里挑戰史詩級的《致命武器》系列，測試4個不同的場景。

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S05:E02 - Jean Claude Van Schappert
programme.desc: 特里進入慢動作和爆炸的世界，試圖模仿尚-克勞德在《硬目標》中的表現。特里和拉里將測試《硬目標》電影中的5個場景。其中之一會讓你再也不想透過瞄準孔看了。
programme.sub-title: Hollywood Weapons - S05:E02 - Jean Claude Van Schappert

programme.title: The New Frontier - S04:E03 - Tickets Please
programme.desc: Las empresas de vuelos espaciales comerciales están cada vez más cerca de estar preparadas para volar. Pronto se lanzarán al espacio clientes de pago; se prevé que los ingresos por turismo sean un importante peldaño hacia la exploración y colonización del espacio.
programme.sub-title: The New Frontier - S04:E03 - Tickets Please

programme.title: The New Frontier - S04:E04 - Planet X
programme.desc: La misión New Horizons sigue adentrándose en el espacio. Ante la proximidad de su próximo objetivo, algunos especulan con la posibilidad de que haya indicios de la existencia de un nuevo planeta misterioso, largamente envuelto en el folclore. ¿Podría existir el Planeta X?
programme.sub-title: The New Frontier - S04:E04 - Planet X

programme.title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E09 - Private Military Contractors
programme.desc: La práctica de contratar ejércitos privados se remonta a la antigüedad, y la mística asociada al guerrero mercenario ha sido objeto de numerosos estudios históricos y caracterizaciones de ficción. Este episodio de CQB examina desde una perspectiva más contemporánea un día en la vida de un grupo de contratistas civiles, y cómo ha evolucionado su papel en el campo de batalla moderno. Gracias a sus técnicas de análisis en "sub-segundos" y a sus imágenes en primera persona, CQB desvela los antecedentes, el entrenamiento y el equipamiento de los "soldados de alquiler" de hoy en día, y cómo los ejércitos privados están cambiando la forma en que se desarrollan los conflictos en todo el mundo.
programme.sub-title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E09 - Private Military Contractors

programme.title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E10 - Close Protection
programme.desc: Desde los ex miembros de élite de las fuerzas especiales encargados de custodiar a jefes de Estado en zonas de conflicto hasta los equipos de dos personas que protegen a directores ejecutivos en regiones peligrosas, los guardaespaldas de hoy en día deben conocer bien las técnicas de combate cuerpo a cuerpo. Cada operación requiere un enorme trabajo de planificación y preparación. Desde los viajes en avión, los convoyes de coches y las lanzaderas de helicópteros hasta el tráfico básico a pie, un escuadrón de escolta debe estar completamente al tanto del Quién, Qué, Dónde y Cuándo de cualquier situación. Este episodio de CQB se centra en las complejas operaciones cotidianas y minuto a minuto de estos equipos de élite y en las técnicas altamente desarrolladas que emplean.
programme.sub-title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E10 - Close Protection

programme.sub-title: Hollywood Weapons - S05:E02 - Jean Claude Van Schappert

programme.title: The New Frontier - S04:E03 - Tickets Please
programme.desc: Las empresas de vuelos espaciales comerciales están cada vez más cerca de estar preparadas para volar. Pronto se lanzarán al espacio clientes de pago; se prevé que los ingresos por turismo sean un importante peldaño hacia la exploración y colonización del espacio.
programme.sub-title: The New Frontier - S04:E03 - Tickets Please

programme.title: The New Frontier - S04:E04 - Planet X
programme.desc: La misión New Horizons sigue adentrándose en el espacio. Ante la proximidad de su próximo objetivo, algunos especulan con la posibilidad de que haya indicios de la existencia de un nuevo planeta misterioso, largamente envuelto en el folclore. ¿Podría existir el Planeta X?
programme.sub-title: The New Frontier - S04:E04 - Planet X

programme.title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E09 - Private Military Contractors
programme.desc: La práctica de contratar ejércitos privados se remonta a la antigüedad, y la mística asociada al guerrero mercenario ha sido objeto de numerosos estudios históricos y caracterizaciones de ficción. Este episodio de CQB examina desde una perspectiva más contemporánea un día en la vida de un grupo de contratistas civiles, y cómo ha evolucionado su papel en el campo de batalla moderno. Gracias a sus técnicas de análisis en "sub-segundos" y a sus imágenes en primera persona, CQB desvela los antecedentes, el entrenamiento y el equipamiento de los "soldados de alquiler" de hoy en día, y cómo los ejércitos privados están cambiando la forma en que se desarrollan los conflictos en todo el mundo.
programme.sub-title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E09 - Private Military Contractors

programme.title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E10 - Close Protection
programme.desc: Desde los ex miembros de élite de las fuerzas especiales encargados de custodiar a jefes de Estado en zonas de conflicto hasta los equipos de dos personas que protegen a directores ejecutivos en regiones peligrosas, los guardaespaldas de hoy en día deben conocer bien las técnicas de combate cuerpo a cuerpo. Cada operación requiere un enorme trabajo de planificación y preparación. Desde los viajes en avión, los convoyes de coches y las lanzaderas de helicópteros hasta el tráfico básico a pie, un escuadrón de escolta debe estar completamente al tanto del Quién, Qué, Dónde y Cuándo de cualquier situación. Este episodio de CQB se centra en las complejas operaciones cotidianas y minuto a minuto de estos equipos de élite y en las técnicas altamente desarrolladas que emplean.
programme.sub-title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E10 - Close Protection

programme.desc: Sumérgete en la temporada de Dropped mientras los hermanos recapitulan una épica aventura de 30 días a través de la sabana canadiense.
